Brightwheel: pricing, setup & what to know before you sign

An honest owner's guide — and what it costs compared to simpler options.

Brightwheel is the biggest name in childcare software — check-in, daily reports, messaging, billing and admin in one app, used by tens of thousands of programs. Here's the practical owner's view.

How Brightwheel pricing works

Brightwheel doesn't publish simple pricing — plans are quote-based through a sales call, typically per-program subscriptions that scale with size and features. Owners commonly report costs in the $150–$400+/month range for centres, plus payment-processing fees on tuition. Always get a current quote; pricing changes.

Setting it up

  1. Book a demo/sales call and get your quote.
  2. Onboarding sessions: import rosters, set rooms and ratios, configure billing plans.
  3. Invite staff, then send parents app-download invitations.
  4. Expect a few weeks to fully settle in — the platform is deep, which cuts both ways.

What it does well — and the common frustrations

Good: mature feature set, polished parent app, strong billing. Frustrations owners cite: price creep as features move between tiers, payment processing cuts on tuition, sales-call-gated everything, and feeling small in a very big customer base when support matters.
